goal: Implement the pulse status board exactly as README.md specifies: GET /api/metrics with measured checks (node, memory, workspace) and counters that include the reading request; the page showing a card per check, the counters and when it last read the service, polling every 5 seconds and reading immediately on Read now; one log line per request on stdout; HTTP-level tests for all of it; and docs/decisions.md recording why there are no dependencies, what in-memory counters mean after a restart, and where the memory ceiling comes from.
done_when: npm test passes and covers the metrics shape, counters rising, the page being served, and a 404 counted as an error
/api/metrics returns measured checks, never constants, and counters include the request that read them
the page shows one card per check with its status colour, the counters and the last read time, and says so in the page when the service is unreachable
each request writes one line to stdout with method, path, status and duration
docs/decisions.md records the three decisions the README names
